title: damage
description: Apply damage to the specified entities. See more in the [Damage Command documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/minecraft/creator/documents/commandsdamageintroduction).

target.title: target
target.description: Required. The target to damage. A player name or [target selector](https://learn.microsoft.com/minecraft/creator/documents/commandsintroduction#target-selectors).

amount.title: amount
amount.description: Required. Default `0`. An `integer` that specifies the amount of damage.

cause.title: cause
cause.description: Optional. Default `none`. An `enum` of the damage cause.

damager.title: damager
damager.description: A `selector` that specifies which entity will be treated as dealing the damage to the target. Should be one entity or player.
